## TemplateEngine.\_PAGE\_ATTR\_VALUE\_VALIDATORS property

Attribute value validators for `<g-*>` PAGE blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _PAGE_ATTR_VALUE_VALIDATORS: Record<string, Record<string, (value: string) => string | null>>;
```

## Remarks

Per-tag, per-attribute map of validators. Each validator receives the raw attribute value (after quote-stripping) and returns either `null` (valid) or a descriptive error string. The value validation runs after the per-block attribute validation, so unknown attributes are reported separately by `validateBlockG*Attributes` methods.

Currently covers: - `<g-base id>` — must not be empty - `<g-keyboard type>` — must be `inline` or `bottom` - `<g-media type>` — must be one of: photo, video, audio, document, animation, voice, video\_note, sticker, location, contact - `<g-media shared>` — must be `true` or `false`

Validators are intentionally lenient — they catch obvious bugs (wrong type, invalid value) but do not enforce every framework-level constraint.

## Example


```typescript
TemplateEngine._PAGE_ATTR_VALUE_VALIDATORS["g-keyboard"].type("inline")   // => null
TemplateEngine._PAGE_ATTR_VALUE_VALIDATORS["g-keyboard"].type("sidebar") // => "Attribute \"type\" on <g-keyboard> must be \"inline\" or \"bottom\", got \"sidebar\""
```
